s: Lehizzaher bikbod shabbat ubo y"g seipim: shene debarim nitpareshu beshabbat al yede hannebiim, vehem kabod veoneg, shenneemar "veqarata lashshabbat oneg liqdosh Hashem mekubbad". Veiqqaran min hattora, shehashshabbat hu biklal miqrae qodesh, shenneemar "ubayyom hashshebii shabbat shabbaton miqra qodesh vego'". U"miqra qodesh" pereshu chakamim: leqaddesho ulekabbedo biksut neqiyya, uleannego beoneg akila ushetiyya. Veyesh omerim she"miqra qodesh" hu leqaddesho beissur asiyyat melaka, abal hakkabod beshabbat veyom tob vehaoneg beshabbat hen middibre soperim (abal haoneg vehassimcha beyom tob bemaakal umishteh hu min hattora, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tqk"t). Umikkol maqom, tzarik lehizzaher bahem meod, shechamurim dibre soperim yoter middibre tora. Vekol hamanneg et hashshabbat sekaro meporash beqabbala: "az titannag al Hashem vego'", ubedibre raza"l, shemmochalin lo al kol avonotayv venitztzol middinah shel gehinnom:

Bammeh meannego? Bime chakme haggemara hayu meannegin bedagim gedolim ubetabshil shel teradin, shemmaakalim ellu hayu chashubim oneg bimehem. Vekol maqom umaqom lepi minhago yeanneguhu bemaakalim umashqim hachashubim lahem oneg. Veen chiyyub leekol basar velishtot yayin beshabbat, ella lepi shemmin hassetam yesh lerob bene adam oneg baakilat basar yoter mibbishar maakalim ubishtiyyat yayin yoter mibbishar mashqim, lekak yesh lahem leharbot bebasar veyayin kepi yekoltam vehassagat yadam:

Vekol hammarbeh behotzaat shabbat ubetiqqun maakalim rabbim vetobim — hare zeh meshubbach, vehu sheyyado masseget. Veap im en lo akshav maot mezummanim ella chapatzim — yemashkenem veyilveh alehem, vehaqqadosh baruk hu yamtzi lo liproa. Veal zeh ameru raza"l: "amar haqqadosh baruk hu levu alay vaani porea", kelomar sheen hotzaat shabbat veyom tob oleh becheshbon haqqitzba shenniqtzab lo berosh hashshana limzonot kol hashshana ushear tzerakayv, shekkak ameru chakamim: kol mezonotayv vehotzaotayv shel adam qetzubin lo merosh hashshana, sheqqotzebin lo kamma yistakker beshana zo letzorek mezonotayv ushear tzerakayv shel kol yemot hashshana, chutz mehotzaot shabbatot veyamim tobim, sheen qotzebin aleha kelum, ella im mosip behotzaat shabbat veyom tob — mosipin lo. Abal im en lo chapatzim lemashkenam veliproa bahem — lo yilveh veshehaqqadosh baruk hu yipra, ki meachar sheen lo mishshello — en alayv chiyyub kelal leharbot behotzaat shabbat yoter mehassagat yado:

Veap im en yado masseget kelum verotzeh littol min haqquppa shel tzedaqa hammitchalleqet bekol ereb shabbat — lo yittol im eno tzarik littol letzorek mezonotayv shel yemot hachol shel shabua habba, ubishbil mezonot yom hashshabbat gam ken lo haya tzarik littol im haya noheg kibchol mammash leekol bo shette seuddot bilbad pat veqitniyyot kisuddotayv bechol, kegon sheyyesh lo mezon y"d seuddot leshiba yamim, shead ereb shabbat habba seudda achat lekol yom useudda achat lekol layla, ella sherotzeh littol kede leekol shelosha seuddot beshabbat. Vekol shekken im rotzeh littol kede lehitanneg qetzat yoter mimot hachol, sheasur lo littol min haqquppa beshabua zo, shekkak ameru chakamim "aseh shabbatteka chol veal titztarek labberiyyot":

Abal beereb shabbat habba notenin lo mezon t"v seuddot leotah shabua, kede sheyyihyeh lo shelosha seuddot leoto shabbat, vegam notenim lo dagim veyaraq leoto shabbat, shekkevan shekkebar nitzrak labberiyyot notenim lo kol tzorko, shenneemar "de machsoro asher yechsar lo". Veken mi shennotenim lo midde shabua beshabua mitztzedaqa acheret, shemmuttar lo leqabbel mimmenna harbeh kol sheen lo shiur hamporash beyoreh dea simman rn"g — hare zeh yakol leharbot behotzaat shabbat kepi erek mah shennotenim lo. (Ubilbad shello yotzi kol kak leshabbatot ad shettechsar parnasato bechol veyitztareku lehosip lo min hatztzedaqa mechamat hotzaotayv leshabbatot, shennimtza mattil kebod shabbetotayv al habberiyyot, ukebar ameru "aseh shabbatteka chol veal titztarek labberiyyot"):

Veim mah shennotenim lo eno maspiq lo leharbot behotzaat shabbat vesheyyotir mizzeh leparnasato lechol beinyan sheyyitztareku lehosip lo, mikkol maqom im yesh lo meat mishshello — yezarez et atzmo lehotzi mamon bikbod hashshabbat bekol mah sheepshar. Abal im en lo kelum mishshello — en tzarik lebaqqesh meacherim sheyyittenu lo kede lekabbed et hashshabbat, shekkebar ameru "aseh shabbatteka ku'". Umikkol maqom, tzarik hu laasot dabar muat betok beto leqayyem mitzvat oneg. Veim mah shennotenim lo eno maspiq lo apillu ledabar muat — tzarik hu letzamtzem meat bishar hayyamim beinyan sheyyukal laasot dabar muat leoneg shabbat. Vekol shekken mi sheeno notel kelum mehatztzedaqa ella mistappeq bammuat sheyyesh lo mishshello, sheeno tzarik lebaqqesh meacherim sheyyittenu lo kede lekabbed et hashshabbat, ella yetzamtzem meat bishar hayyamim beinyan sheyyaaseh dabar muat leoneg shabbat, vezeh tob yoter mishsheyyitztarek labberiyyot:

Ap mi sheen yado masseget leharbot bemaakale shabbat — tob lo lizzaher shello yipchot mishshene tabshilin. Vetob lizzaher leekol dagim bekol seudda, ella im ken haddagim mazziqim lo lepi tibo, o shessoneam, sheen lo mehem oneg ella tzaar, vehashshabbat leoneg nittan, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman rp"ch. Veim hannokrim meyaqqerim hashshaar shel haddagim umechamat zeh yesh kamma bene adam sheen yekolim liqqach dagim leshabbat — nakon letaqqen shello yiqneh shum yisrael mehem dagim ezeh shabbatot, kede sheachar kak yozilu hashshaar, veyukelu hakkol leqayyem mitzvat oneg shabbat:
Im shalechu leadam ezeh debar maakal sheyyoklennu beshabbat — al yoklennu bechol (mimmiddat chasidut, abal min haddin en issur baddabar, ayyen simman trtz"d):
Muttar lilvot beribbit shel dibrehem letzorek seuddat shabbat veyom tob, o letzorek shear seuddat mitzva, im i epshar lilvot belo ribbit:

"Zakor et yom hashshabbat leqaddesho vego'", dareshu bet shammay shettehe zokero meechad bashshabbat, sheim nizdammen leka cheleq yapeh tehe metaqqeno leshabbat. Veameru alayv al shammay hazzaqen shekkol yamayv haya okel likbod shabbat, ketzad? Matza behema naa — loqechah veomer "zo leshabbat", matza acheret naa hemenna — loqechah umannichah leshabbat, veokel et harishona bechol, nimtza okelah lezo kede shehayyapa teakel beshabbat. Abal hillel hazzaqen midda acheret hayeta bo, shehaya omer "baruk Hashem yom yom yaamas lanu tzerakenu". Veap hillel modeh shekkedibre bet shammay yoter nakon laasot, ella shehaya boteach baHashem shebbevadday yazmin lo leshabbat mana yapa mikkol hayyamim:

Ezra tiqqen sheyyihyu mekabbesim begadim bachamishi bashshabbat, mippene kebod hashshabbat, kede lilbosh lebanim beshabbat, abal beereb shabbat en penay lekabbes, mippene shetztzarik lehitasseq betzorke shabbat:

Nohagin lalush kede shiur challa kol echad bebeto laasot mehem lechamim libtzoa alehem beshabbat, velo liqqach lechem min hashshuq kemo bishar yamim, vedabar zeh mikkebod shabbat veyom tob, veen leshannot hamminhag:
(Ubimqomot sheokelim pat shel nokrim kol yemot hachol — tob lizzaher shello leekol beshabbat veyom tob ki im millechamim hakkesherim shennilloshu bebeto, shezzehu kebod shabbat veyom tob):
